India vs Nepal, Men’s U19 Asia Cup: Squads, live streaming info — all you need to know
 Here’s everything you need to know about the Under-19 Asia Cup clash between India U-19 and Nepal U-19 in Muscat on Friday.

 FILE PHOTO: Lakshya Raichandani will captain India Under-19 during the U-19 Men’s Asia Cup in Oman.
 | Photo Credit: SLC
 FILE PHOTO: Lakshya Raichandani will captain India Under-19 during the U-19 Men’s Asia Cup in Oman.
 | Photo Credit: SLC
 India Under-19 will get its Men’s Asia Cup 2026 campaign underway against Nepal U-19 at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground in Muscat, Oman on Friday, November 6.
 Lakshya Raichandani will lead India, with Yashbhardan Singh Chauhan as his deputy. The squad also includes Aaryavir Sehwag and Anvay Dravid, sons of Indian cricket legends Virender Sehwag and Rahul Dravid.
 India and Nepal have been drawn in Group A. Pakistan and UAE are the other two teams in the group. The top two teams will progress to the semifinals to be played on November 12.
 SQUADS
 India: Lakshya Raichandani [C], Aaryavir Sehwag, V.K. Vineeth, Yashbardhan Singh Chauhan [VC], Kushagra Ojha, Arjun Rajput, Manal Chauhan, Anvay Dravid [WK], Rajat Baghel [WK], V. Yashveer, Aryan Savsani, Mohit Ulva, Kavya Patel, Shavin Vinod, Ishan Sood
 Nepal: Bipin Sharma(c), Aashish Luhar(w), Niraj Kumar Yadav, Rohit Chand, Prashiddha Jaishi, Sohail Kunwar, Darsh Sonar, Nischal Chhetri, Sachin Bhatt, Roshan Shahi, Suryanshu Koirala, Abhay Yadav, Sushil Rawal, Subham Khanal, Nitesh Patel
 LIVE STREAMING INFO
 What time is the India U-19 vs Nepal U-19 match scheduled to begin? 
 The Group A encounter between India U-19 and Nepal U-19 will begin at 10:30 am IST on Friday, with the toss scheduled 30 minutes prior.
 Where can we watch the India vs Nepal Under-19 Asia Cup match? 
 The contest will be telecast on the Sony Sports Network with live streaming available via the SonyLIV app and website.
